en_title: Sony and Lionsgate Team up For Naruto Movie, Filming to Begin in Spring 2027
cn_title: 索尼与狮门影业联手打造《火影忍者》电影，计划于2027年春季开拍
opus_summary: 索尼与Lionsgate确认合作推出《Naruto》真人电影，目标于2027年春季开拍。Lionsgate负责制作及美国国内发行，索尼影业负责国际发行。影片由德斯汀·克里顿执导，目前尚无确认的演员阵容；据报道，查尔斯·梅尔顿曾就饰演Kakashi进行商谈。

paragraphs.en: Sony and Lionsgate have teamed up for the live-action Naruto movie, which is targeting a spring 2027 start date.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼与狮门影业已联手打造《火影忍者》真人电影，目标于2027年春季开拍。

paragraphs.en: Sony and Lionsgate have confirmed they will work together on Destin Daniel Cretton's live-action Naruto movie , with Lionsgate handling production and domestic distribution. Sony Pictures will handle international distribution. Lionsgate noted in a statement that Sony is a great partner for this specific project given its experience with anime and manga (Sony owns Crunchyroll, for instance).
paragraphs.cn: 索尼与狮门影业已确认，将合作推出德斯汀·克里顿执导的《火影忍者》真人电影，其中狮门影业负责制作和美国国内发行，索尼影业负责国际发行。狮门影业在一份声明中指出，鉴于索尼在日本动画和漫画领域的经验，它是这个特定项目的绝佳合作伙伴（例如，索尼拥有Crunchyroll）。

paragraphs.en: “As a longtime fan of Naruto, I’ve always loved that beneath the extraordinary action is a story filled with heart, humor, and humanity," said director Destin Daniel Cretton. "Kishimoto-sensei created a world where unlikely heroes do extraordinary things, and that’s what makes it so special. Lionsgate has been an incredible partner, and I’m thrilled to reunite with the fantastic team at Sony. Together, we’re committed to capturing everything fans love about Naruto while introducing it to a whole new generation. I can’t wait for everyone to see what we’re creating.”
paragraphs.cn: 导演德斯汀·克里顿说：「作为《火影忍者》的长期粉丝，我一直很喜欢它非凡动作场面之下那个充满温情、幽默和人性的故事。岸本老师创造了一个世界，在那里，出人意料的英雄做出非凡之事，这正是它如此特别的原因。狮门影业一直是出色的合作伙伴，我很高兴能与索尼优秀的团队再次合作。我们将共同致力于呈现粉丝们喜爱《火影忍者》的一切，同时将它介绍给全新的一代。我迫不及待想让大家看到我们正在创作的作品。」

paragraphs.en: The Naruto movie has officially been greenlit by Lionsgate and is now barreling toward a production start date of spring 2027. As a result, we should hear more news on casting in the coming weeks and months. There's currently no confirmed cast for the film at the moment, but actor Charles Melton was reportedly in talks to play Kakashi back in August. Naruto will likely be one of the hottest projects in Hollywood ahead of its production start, with lots of younger actors likely trying to fight for a spot in the ensemble.
paragraphs.cn: 《火影忍者》电影已正式获得狮门影业批准，正全速推进，计划于2027年春季开拍。因此，我们应该会在未来几周和几个月内听到更多选角消息。目前影片尚无确定的演员阵容，但据报道，演员查尔斯·梅尔顿早在8月就曾就饰演卡卡西一角进行洽谈。《火影忍者》在开拍前很可能会成为好莱坞最炙手可热的项目之一，许多年轻演员可能会争取在演员阵容中占据一席之地。

paragraphs.en: Destin Daniel Cretton just directed Spider-Man: Brand New Day, which grossed over $2.5 billion and became the third-highest-grossing film in history. Naturally, it makes sense that Sony would want to be involved with his next project, and it's likely other people in Hollywood will want to get on board as well. Cretton also did a bang-up job on Marvel's Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings, which has given audiences more confidence in his Naruto movie.
paragraphs.cn: 德斯汀·克里顿刚刚执导了《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》，该片票房超过25亿美元，成为影史票房第三高的电影。索尼想要参与他的下一个项目自然合情合理，好莱坞其他人也很可能想要加入。克里顿执导漫威的《尚气与十环传奇》时也表现出色，这让观众对他的《火影忍者》电影更有信心。

paragraphs.en: Unfortunately, there isn't much precedent for great live-action adaptations of anime. Dragon Ball infamously got a live-action film known as Dragonball Evolution in 2009. It is genuinely awful and it may have scared Hollywood away from trying to adapt other anime after this. Maybe Naruto will crack the code, though.
paragraphs.cn: 遗憾的是，优秀的日本动画真人改编作品并没有多少先例。《龙珠》在2009年曾被拍成一部名为《七龙珠》的真人电影，臭名昭著。这部电影确实糟糕透顶，它可能吓得好莱坞此后不敢再尝试改编其他日本动画。不过，也许《火影忍者》能找到成功的诀窍。
